content.text:
**Finding submitted: compliant (preferred position).**

No MFN burdens the Company. The sole parity covenant (§1.8) obliges HDI to promote our Site and Deerskin Products no less favorably than its own catalog titles — an MFN-style benefit flowing to us, which we leave untouched. The fee article is a fixed revenue share with no best-pricing or third-party-matching trigger, and §7.1's "reciprocal and equitable" cross-promotion is a mutual marketing covenant rather than an obligation to pass HDI our best third-party terms. No redline proposed.
